title: Sidecar Comments v1 public JSON protocol
description: The top-level instance is exactly one v1 response envelope or an apply request. Duplicate JSON member detection, lexical number rules, byte limits, UTF-8/NFC, UUID non-nilness, base64 decoding, and cross-field semantics are normative prose requirements in docs/v1/protocol.md.

ValidationDetails.description: Location grammar failures use target_content/location; source coordinate and anchor resolution failures use source_coordinate/location and source_anchor/location respectively.

ThreadID.description: A ThreadID is a UUIDv7 in the thread-ID namespace; it is not a MessageID.

MessageID.description: A MessageID is a UUIDv7 in the message-ID namespace; it is not a ThreadID.
